podcast.title: View on 70s Rock Subgenres
podcast.body: Anne Wilson described the proliferation of subgenres in 1970s rock as significant "musical inbreeding" due to the constant shifting of personnel and mutual influences within bands. She characterized this fragmentation as a "big jam," reflecting a dynamic and interconnected musical landscape. "there is so much musical inbreeding that goes on, then that's of course a shifting of personnel in the influence that you are bound to have on each other, that it's just a big jam as she put it."
